linkedDocuments.summary: Physiotherapy progress note for Alex Morgan following a right ankle inversion injury. Patient reports reduced pain and minimal swelling with improved gait, though dorsiflexion and single-leg balance remain impaired compared to the left side.
Patient presents with a Grade II right lateral ankle sprain following an inversion injury. X-ray shows no acute fracture or dislocation. Management includes RICE, bracing, and physiotherapy.
Prescription for Grade II right lateral ankle sprain including Naproxen, Pantoprazole, and Diclofenac gel, with instructions for ankle brace use and physiotherapy referral.
